extension.description: Stremio for Kodi program addon with embedded Nimbus Home and media information. Nimbus layouts and artwork by Ivar Brandt. Kodi remains the playback engine; the global Kodi skin is unchanged.
extension.news: 1.0.49: Bring Kodi AI subtitle translation in line with Noiro: normal movie/episode tracks now use one large validated Gemini request when possible, oversized tracks split only at 2,400 cues or 120k text characters, the proven Noiro Flash-Lite model order is used, and the last successful model is preferred on the next translation.
